item.description: Kigali has once again been named Africa’s cleanest city in 2025 by The Africa Report, with Rabat holding firmly onto second place, even as the methodology behind the rankings evolved. item.title: How Mombasa built its street food culture
item.description: Historian Devin Smart’s new book, “Preparing the Modern Meal,” traces how urbanization transformed Kenya’s food culture, with Mombasa as a vibrant case study. item.title: How AI and satellites are mapping Africa
item.description: A new Abu Dhabi- and Microsoft-backed initiative, Map Africa, aims to transform how the continent is planned, governed, and protected by building a live, continuously updated digital map of all 54 African countries. item.title: Cameroon knocks out South Africa in AFCON match
item.description: Cameroon booked their place in the AFCON quarterfinals with a hard-fought 2–1 win over South Africa, setting up a blockbuster clash with hosts Morocco. Goals from Junior Tchamadeu before halftime and teenage striker Christian Kofane just after the break proved decisive, despite a late rally that saw Evidence Makgopa pull one back for Bafana Bafana. item.title: DRC and Liberia join UN Security Council
item.description: The UN Security Council has welcomed five new non-permanent members—Bahrain, Colombia, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Latvia, and Liberia—for the 2026–2027 term, reshaping the global body’s diplomatic mix. For the DRC, the seat marks a return after 35 years and comes with renewed emphasis on peacekeeping reform, drawing on its long experience hosting the MONUSCO mission. […]

item.title: Botswana courts Russian partnership on rare earths
item.description: Botswana is strengthening its ties with Russia, announcing plans to open an embassy in Moscow.
